definitions.gloss: report-contact-consult, communication basics in the workplace
definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of {報告|ほうこく} (report), {連絡|れんらく} (contact/inform), and {相談|そうだん} (consult). A fundamental workplace communication principle in Japan emphasizing that employees should proactively report progress, share relevant information, and consult superiors when problems arise.

examples.japanese: {報連相|ほうれんそう}を{忘|わす}れないでください。
examples.english: Please don't forget to report, contact, and consult.

examples.japanese: {新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん}{研修|けんしゅう}で{報連相|ほうれんそう}の{大切|たいせつ}さを{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I learned the importance of report-contact-consult during new employee training.

examples.japanese: {報連相|ほうれんそう}がしっかりしているチームは{問題|もんだい}が{起|お}きても{素早|すばや}く{対応|たいおう}できる。
examples.english: A team that practices good report-contact-consult can respond quickly even when problems arise.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
A portmanteau of {報告|ほうこく} (report), {連絡|れんらく} (contact/inform), and {相談|そうだん} (consult). The abbreviation deliberately sounds like ほうれん{草|そう} (spinach), making it a memorable mnemonic.

USAGE:
One of the most widely taught workplace communication concepts in Japan, introduced to nearly all new employees. It is considered a foundational skill for smooth teamwork and is frequently referenced in business books and training materials. Failure to practice {報連相|ほうれんそう} is a common criticism of junior employees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {報連相|ほうれんそう}を{徹底|てってい}する: thoroughly practice report-contact-consult
- {報連相|ほうれんそう}が{大事|だいじ}: report-contact-consult is important
- {報連相|ほうれんそう}ができない: unable to properly report/contact/consult
